en.headline: No own commits; 14 automated commits, 1 issue comment, 1 reply received
en.summary: On 2026-10-12, `sogeisetsu` recorded **0 own commits** across the day, with no pull requests, reviews, or releases. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, there were 14 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`, separate from the user's own count. The user commented on issue `#4664` in `openchamber/openchamber`, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity". That issue was not opened by the user. The user also received one reply: `terry-an-investor` commented on issue `#51263` in `anomalyco/opencode`, titled "websearch: tinyfish provider returns HTTP 400 (missing Mcp-Session-Id) on every search", confirming the failure on `v2.0.27` and noting it is key-presence-dependent. No discussions were started or joined, and no stars were added.
